# Marketing action forced-colors compatibility

Exact, unmodified files from `hraness/design-kit` commit `3d28bc3ceceecd98e5ec1ccff57b7da0ec17539c` (package version `0.29.1`). This focused snapshot preserves this site’s existing design-kit dependency and ordinary light/dark appearance.

- `marketing-forced-colors.css`: upstream [`src/marketing-forced-colors.css`](https://github.com/hraness/design-kit/blob/3d28bc3ceceecd98e5ec1ccff57b7da0ec17539c/src/marketing-forced-colors.css), SHA-256 `11b42385c6a0380b1101a5504e6959fa432d3801cff2f29f2cdb718d3eb4925a`.
- `LICENSE`: upstream [`LICENSE`](https://github.com/hraness/design-kit/blob/3d28bc3ceceecd98e5ec1ccff57b7da0ec17539c/LICENSE), SHA-256 `763eaf6783097cac7303f10321b33ffc6a88c35845ba1e592b6a750e4568c5e0`.

Import the stylesheet after the existing marketing styles. Product-specific forced-colors overrides must use the same `ButtonText` and `ButtonFace` system colors.
